name: KICK THE DEMON OUT!
source:
t’s the night of All Hallow’s Eve. You are a Bouncer, and your club is flowing with guests and drinks. Despite the festive celebration, they are quite manageable, and the night seems to be turning uneventful… 

Until your Boss asks you to...

KICK THE DEMON OUT!

Meet Caleb! The (alleged) demon you have to kick out by midnight! Give him drinks, talk with him, then decide whether he’s worthy to be kicked out or not in this spooky-vibes four-phase visual novel game!
translation:
这是万圣节前夜。你是一名保镖，你的俱乐部里挤满了客人和饮料。尽管有节日庆祝活动，但他们还是很容易控制的，夜晚似乎变得平静…… 

直到你的老板要求你…

赶走恶魔！

认识迦勒！你必须在午夜之前赶走（所谓的）恶魔！给他饮料，与他交谈，然后决定他是否值得在这款令人毛骨悚然的四阶段视觉小说游戏中被踢出去！
